class.name: Box3DPhysicsDirectSpaceState3D

class.description: Implements [PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D] for Box3D spaces, including ray and shape queries. Access the current space state through [member World3D.direct_space_state] or [method PhysicsServer3D.space_get_direct_state], following the inherited query and physics-step requirements.
